title: Moxiecraft
description: Best SMP and MMORPG server in the universe!
body:
Moxiecraft is a survival server and an MMORPG server combined, running on (most of the time) the **latest version of Minecraft** with ViaVersion installed just in case we haven't updated yet. Moxiecraft enables you to do everything, that you can do in vanilla Minecraft: build redstone contraptions, construct massive builds, travel around and hang out with friends. There are also countless dungeons with unique plotlines and loot.

Additionally, Moxiecraft also has these features:

* A large 80K by 80K world!
* BlueMap to view the world from your web browser
* A massive rail network to travel around the world
* Regular events
* Optional proximity voice chat through [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)

\*we have mob griefing, fire spread and TNT disabled for convenience :)

## Events?

YES! Usually there is **at least 1 per month,** but often there are more. These range all the way from **drop parties** with building materials, to **scavenger hunts** and games. One wouldn't obtain anything overpowered, the most exciting thing you could get is an **exclusive collectible item** or two to mark the event

## Dungeons?

Indeed. The server is home to quite a large quantity of them. They are, however, not meant for just anybody. The dungeons are content that should be explored **after you beat the main game**, if you want to. The **minimum armour required is** ***netherite***, and it gets harder from there. From dungeons, you obtain custom RPG-like loot to help you on your journey forward. IMPORTANT: **THESE ARE COMPLETELY** ***OPTIONAL***, aka. if RPG dungeons aren't your thing, you don't have to do them. They are purely for fun after beating the game.

You are, however, still always living in this magical world full of lore and mystery.

## What about grief?

On Moxiecraft, grief is forbidden. If you grief — **you get banned**! Simple as :)

If anything does end up being griefed, do not worry, because our moderators and admins will identify the griefer and **restore everything** griefed! If your build hasn't been fixed already, please notify someone, so they can do it quicker.

On Moxiecraft, stealing from chests is allowed, because we have Bolt installed, which allows you to `/lock` your chests (and other containers), so that nobody is able to steal from them :)

# Server rules

Moxiecraft has 4 rules:

1. Do not *grief*
2. Do not *cheat*
3. Do not *spam* in chat
4. Do not *harass* others

You can read more in depth about them at server spawn or [at our website](https://moxiecraft.org/rules/)!

# How to connect?

You can connect to Moxiecraft by using the following IP address: [`moxiecraft.org`](http://moxiecraft.org)  
You should also check out our website at [https://moxiecraft.org](https://moxiecraft.org) :D

Moxiecraft also has a [Discord server](https://discord.gg/tafwCu8t), where people can discuss various topics, add suggestions, read announcements and talk to people in the game! We are currently also moving to a self hosted IRC and Matrix solution :D
